Overview

This feature service provides comprehensive geographic data on paddle routes across Canada, designed to support the planning, promotion, and management of recreational paddling activities. The dataset encompasses various types of routes, each serving unique recreational purposes.

Feature Layers

  • Paddle Network: This layer details multiple paddle routes characterized by their names, local communities, difficulty levels, and route lengths. It categorizes routes into distinct types such as Canadian Heritage River Routes, Connectors, Great River Runs, Loops & Lakes, and Signature Routes, facilitating diverse paddle experiences. The data aids in identifying routes that vary by challenge and ambiance, enhancing paddlers' safety and enjoyment.

Geographic Coverage

The data spans a broad geographic extent covering Canadian communities and noteworthy paddle waterways. It is suitable for national and regional scale applications related to outdoor recreation and tourism.

Use Cases

  • Supporting tourism websites and applications focused on water-based recreational activities.
  • Assisting community planners and local governments in managing and promoting paddle routes.
  • Enhancing outdoor enthusiasts' ability to discover and select appropriate paddle routes by difficulty and type.
